standard._min_pct_above_52w_low: price at least 30% above the 52-week low (your 'true 30%'; in TradingView: 'Price above Low 52W by 30% or more')

EP-GAPUP-BREAKOUT._close_chg_pct: the gap day must also CLOSE up this much or more vs the day before (the user, Nov 14 2026: 'it has to close above 5% for the day'); 0 = off

DAILY TIGHTNESS._min_tight_days: today is a tight day and at least 3 of the last 5 days (today included) were tight (low volume + narrow range); set within_last_days to 3 for 3 in a row
DAILY TIGHTNESS._range_vs_avg10_max: today's high-low range at most 0.8 x the average range of the previous 10 days (same as MSF 'Tight day: range <= X x 10-day avg range'); 0 = off

screeners._rel_vol_days: relative volume = the day's volume vs the average of this many sessions before it; 20, the same as Launches, Start days and TradingView (the user, Nov 17 2026: 'for rvol it should 20'; was 10)

lists._new_mover_days_without_setup: 1-UPDAY: off after this many trading days without reaching 3-SETUPS; 0 = off (the user, Nov 21 2026: 'take 15 day rule of for upday as well'; was 15; off 1-EP/GAP since Nov 14)
lists._delete_below_pre_gap_close: 1-EP/GAP: off the list on a close below the close of the day before the gap = the whole gap given back (the user, Nov 14 2026, VIR Nov 12 2026: 12.12 under 12.21); a dip under the gap day's low that holds inside the gap stays
lists._setups_higher_high_low: off (your choice, Oct 25) · strict = the last two swing highs and lows are rising · structure = stays on until price breaks the last higher low
lists._no_chase_1y_pct: off (your choice, Oct 25); a number (e.g. 300) skips stocks up that much in 12 months
